sets.subject: English
sets.passage_en: Saving water begins at home. A leaking tap _____ (1) _____ several litres a day, so repairing it quickly matters. Taking shorter showers also _____ (2) _____ water use. In the kitchen, washing vegetables in a bowl instead of under a running tap _____ (3) _____ wastage. Outdoors, watering plants early in the morning reduces _____ (4) _____ loss. These small habits, practised together, _____ (5) _____ a real difference.
sets.passage_hi: पानी बचाना घर से शुरू होता है। टपकता नल एक दिन में कई लीटर पानी _____ (1) _____ है, इसलिए उसे जल्दी ठीक करना ज़रूरी है। छोटी शॉवर भी पानी का उपयोग _____ (2) _____ करती है। रसोई में सब्ज़ियाँ बहते नल के नीचे के बजाय बाटी में धोने से बर्बादी _____ (3) _____ होती है। बाहर पौधों को सुबह पानी देने से वाष्पन हानि _____ (4) _____ होती है। ये छोटी आदतें मिलकर वास्तविक अंतर _____ (5) _____ करती हैं।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge cloze passage on household water conservation; not an SSC passage.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the word closest in meaning to "diligent".
questions.text_hi: "diligent" के अर्थ के सबसे निकट शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: "Diligent" means showing steady, careful effort, so "hardworking" fits.
questions.solution_hi: "Diligent" का अर्थ है निरंतर और सावधान प्रयास, इसलिए "hardworking" उपयुक्त है।
questions.trick_en: Diligent work is steady work.
questions.trick_hi: Diligent कार्य निरंतर कार्य है।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the word most opposite in meaning to "victory".
questions.text_hi: "victory" के अर्थ के सबसे विपरीत शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: Victory is a win; defeat is a loss.
questions.solution_hi: Victory जीत है; defeat हार।
questions.trick_en: Pair win with loss.
questions.trick_hi: जीत को हार से जोड़ें।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Which spelling is correct for the word meaning 'required'?
questions.text_hi: 'आवश्यक' के अर्थ वाले शब्द की सही वर्तनी कौन-सी है?
questions.solution_en: "Necessary" has one "c" and double "s": n-e-c-e-s-s-a-r-y.
questions.solution_hi: "Necessary" में एक "c" और दोहरा "s": n-e-c-e-s-s-a-r-y।
questions.trick_en: Remember: one collar (c), two sleeves (ss).
questions.trick_hi: याद रखें: एक कॉलर (c), दो आस्तीन (ss)।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: What does "to burn the midnight oil" mean?
questions.text_hi: "to burn the midnight oil" का क्या अर्थ है?

options.en: To study or work late at night
options.hi: To study or work late at night

questions.solution_en: The idiom means to work or study late into the night.
questions.solution_hi: यह मुहावरा रात देर तक काम या अध्ययन करने का अर्थ देता है।
questions.trick_en: Think of an oil lamp used at night.
questions.trick_hi: रात में जलने वाले तेल के दीये को सोचें।

source.citation: Merriam-Webster dictionary sense check, 2026-11-08.

questions.subject: English

questions.solution_en: A mint manufactures coins; a foundry casts metal.
questions.solution_hi: Mint में सिक्के बनते हैं; foundry में धातु ढाली जाती है।

questions.trick_hi: Mint = सिक्का कारखाना।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: One word for "a doctor who treats children":
questions.text_hi: "बच्चों का इलाज करने वाला डॉक्टर" के लिए एक शब्द:
questions.solution_en: A paediatrician treats children; a dermatologist treats skin.
questions.solution_hi: Paediatrician बच्चों का इलाज करता है; dermatologist त्वचा का।
questions.trick_en: Paed- relates to children.
questions.trick_hi: Paed- बच्चों से संबंधित है।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the word closest in meaning to "obsolete".
questions.text_hi: "obsolete" के अर्थ के सबसे निकट शब्द चुनें।
questions.solution_en: "Obsolete" means no longer in use or out of date.
questions.solution_hi: "Obsolete" का अर्थ है अब प्रयोग में नहीं या पुराना।
questions.trick_en: Obsolete technology is replaced by newer technology.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Find the error: The news (A) / are good (B) / today (C) / No error (D).
questions.text_hi: त्रुटि चुनें: The news (A) / are good (B) / today (C) / No error (D)।
questions.solution_en: "News" is an uncountable noun that takes a singular verb, so it should be "is good".
questions.solution_hi: "News" अगणनीय संज्ञा है और एकवचन क्रिया लेती है, इसलिए "is good" होना चाहिए।
questions.trick_en: News, mathematics and physics look plural but take singular verbs.
questions.trick_hi: News, mathematics, physics बहुवचन जैसे दिखते हैं पर एकवचन क्रिया लेते हैं।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Find the error: She prefers (A) / coffee than tea (B) / in the morning (C) / No error (D).
questions.text_hi: त्रुटि चुनें: She prefers (A) / coffee than tea (B) / in the morning (C) / No error (D)।
questions.solution_en: The verb "prefer" takes "to", not "than": she prefers coffee to tea.
questions.solution_hi: "Prefer" के साथ "than" नहीं, "to" आता है: she prefers coffee to tea।
questions.trick_en: Prefer A to B; superior to, senior to.
questions.trick_hi: Prefer A to B; superior to, senior to।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: She is married ___ my cousin.
questions.text_hi: वह मेरे चचेरे भाई से विवाहित है। (रिक्त स्थान भरें)
questions.solution_en: The correct collocation is "married to" someone.
questions.solution_hi: सही संयोजन "married to" है।
questions.trick_en: Married to a person; married in a ceremony.
questions.trick_hi: व्यक्ति के साथ married to; समारोह में married in।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Neither of the answers ___ correct.
questions.text_hi: दोनों उत्तरों में से कोई भी सही नहीं है। (रिक्त स्थान भरें)
questions.solution_en: "Neither of" takes a singular verb, so "is" is correct.
questions.solution_hi: "Neither of" एकवचन क्रिया लेता है, इसलिए "is" सही है।
questions.trick_en: Neither/either of + plural noun + singular verb.
questions.trick_hi: Neither/either of + बहुवचन संज्ञा + एकवचन क्रिया।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: By the time we reached the hall, the film ___.
questions.text_hi: जब तक हम हॉल पहुँचे, फिल्म ___ चुकी थी।
questions.solution_en: The earlier of two past actions takes the past perfect: had started.
questions.solution_hi: दो भूतकालिक क्रियाओं में पहली के लिए past perfect आता है: had started।
questions.trick_en: By the time + past → past perfect for the earlier action.
questions.trick_hi: By the time + भूतकाल → पहली क्रिया के लिए past perfect।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the best improvement: Please return back my book tomorrow.
questions.text_hi: सर्वोत्तम सुधार चुनें: Please return back my book tomorrow.
questions.solution_en: "Return" already means to give back, so "back" is redundant.
questions.solution_hi: "Return" का अर्थ पहले से वापस देना है, इसलिए "back" अनावश्यक है।
questions.trick_en: Avoid return back, reverse back and revert back.
questions.trick_hi: return back, reverse back, revert back से बचें।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Change to passive voice: The teacher is explaining the lesson.
questions.text_hi: कर्मवाच्य में बदलें: The teacher is explaining the lesson.

options.en: The lesson is explained by the teacher.
options.hi: The lesson is explained by the teacher.

options.en: The lesson is being explained by the teacher.
options.hi: The lesson is being explained by the teacher.

options.en: The lesson was being explained by the teacher.
options.hi: The lesson was being explained by the teacher.

options.en: The lesson has been explained by the teacher.
options.hi: The lesson has been explained by the teacher.

questions.solution_en: Present continuous passive is "is/are being + past participle".
questions.solution_hi: वर्तमान अपूर्ण कर्मवाच्य "is/are being + past participle" है।
questions.trick_en: Continuous passive needs "being".
questions.trick_hi: अपूर्ण कर्मवाच्य में "being" आवश्यक।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the correct indirect speech: He said, "Please help me."
questions.text_hi: सही अप्रत्यक्ष कथन चुनें: He said, "Please help me."

options.en: He requested me to help him.
options.hi: He requested me to help him.

options.en: He said that I helped him.
options.hi: He said that I helped him.

options.en: He asked that he help me.
options.hi: He asked that he help me.

questions.solution_en: A request with "please" becomes "requested + object + to + verb": he requested me to help him.
questions.solution_hi: "Please" वाला अनुरोध "requested + कर्म + to + क्रिया" बनता है: he requested me to help him।
questions.trick_en: Requests use requested/advised/ordered + to + verb.
questions.trick_hi: अनुरोध में requested/advised/ordered + to + क्रिया।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Choose the best improvement: She is one of the best movie I have seen.
questions.text_hi: सर्वोत्तम सुधार चुनें: She is one of the best movie I have seen.
questions.solution_en: "One of the best" is followed by a plural noun: one of the best movies.
questions.solution_hi: "One of the best" के बाद बहुवचन संज्ञा आती है: one of the best movies।
questions.trick_en: One of the + plural noun + singular verb.
questions.trick_hi: One of the + बहुवचन संज्ञा + एकवचन क्रिया।

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Rearrange: P. the farmer Q. early R. left S. for the market
questions.text_hi: पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: P. the farmer Q. early R. left S. for the market
questions.solution_en: Subject, adverb, verb, place phrase gives P Q R S.
questions.solution_hi: कर्ता, क्रिया विशेषण, क्रिया, स्थान वाक्यांश से P Q R S बनता है।
questions.trick_en: Subject → adverb → verb → place.
questions.trick_hi: कर्ता → क्रिया विशेषण → क्रिया → स्थान।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.text_en: Rearrange: P. if you practise daily Q. you will R. improve S. your accuracy
questions.text_hi: पुनर्व्यवस्थित करें: P. if you practise daily Q. you will R. improve S. your accuracy
questions.solution_en: The condition comes first, then subject, auxiliary, verb and object: P Q R S.
questions.solution_hi: शर्त पहले, फिर कर्ता, सहायक क्रिया, क्रिया और कर्म: P Q R S।
questions.trick_en: If-clause first, main clause second.
questions.trick_hi: if-उपवाक्य पहले, मुख्य उपवाक्य बाद में।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.sub_topic: Shuffling of sentences in a passage
questions.text_en: Arrange: R. The shop was closed. S. We reached the market. P. We waited outside. Q. The owner finally arrived.
questions.text_hi: व्यवस्थित करें: R. The shop was closed. S. We reached the market. P. We waited outside. Q. The owner finally arrived.
questions.solution_en: Arrival (S), closed shop (R), waiting (P), arrival of owner (Q): S R P Q.
questions.solution_hi: पहुँचना (S), दुकान बंद (R), प्रतीक्षा (P), मालिक का आना (Q): S R P Q।
questions.trick_en: Chronological order of events.
questions.trick_hi: घटनाओं का कालक्रम।

source.citation: Original ExamEdge practice question on the SSC CGL 2026 Tier-I syllabus. Not a PYQ.

questions.subject: English
questions.sub_topic: Shuffling of sentences in a passage
questions.text_en: Arrange: P. The seed grew into a sapling. Q. A child planted a seed. R. Years later it became a large tree. S. She watered it every day.
questions.text_hi: व्यवस्थित करें: P. The seed grew into a sapling. Q. A child planted a seed. R. Years later it became a large tree. S. She watered it every day.
questions.solution_en: Planting (Q), daily watering (S), sapling (P), large tree (R): Q S P R.
questions.solution_hi: बीज बोना (Q), प्रतिदिन पानी (S), पौधा (P), बड़ा वृक्ष (R): Q S P R।
questions.trick_en: Start with the first action, not the result.
questions.trick_hi: परिणाम नहीं, पहली क्रिया से शुरू करें।
